description:
Quick Commit is a focused macOS menu bar utility for creating a local Git checkpoint in one click.

When a selected repository has changes, Quick Commit inspects the working tree, prepares the change, generates a concise commit subject, and creates the commit automatically. It uses Apple Intelligence on device when available and falls back to a deterministic local generator when it is not.

Quick Commit is intentionally local and private:

• No Git command-line process
• No network, push, fetch, or remote operations
• No external AI service
• Repository access is limited to folders you choose
• Existing index changes are preserved with recoverable safety checks

Add a repository, review its change count, and choose Commit. Quick Commit works without Apple Intelligence.
keywords: git,commit,version control,developer tools,source control,menu bar,repository,apple intelligence
promotionalText: Create local Git checkpoints from your menu bar in one click.
